rule.mixed: a weighted average of the club's best {slots} pairs, its best man with its best woman, its second best man with its second best woman and so on ({weights})
rule.doubles: a weighted average of the club's best {slots} pairs: its two best players, the next two and so on ({weights})
rule.singles: a weighted average of the club's best {slots} players ({weights})

strongest.title: Strongest clubs
strongest.combinedIntro: Clubs ranked by their average standing in all five disciplines, each counting equally. In each discipline, a club's strength is compared with the other clubs listed here: 0 is average, +1 is one standard deviation above it. Clubs need to be listed in every discipline.
strongest.poolIntro: Clubs ranked by {rule}. A pair counts at the average of its two players. Places a club can't fill count at the lowest rating among ranked players, so smaller clubs are listed but rank lower.
strongest.noClubs: No clubs yet: run the pipeline.
strongest.sortByRankedPlayers: Sort by ranked players, most first

club.allDisciplinesText: Club strength in each discipline at the end of each week. Doubles ratings are on the same kind of scale as singles, but each discipline is rated on its own, so compare how each line moves rather than the levels between disciplines.
club.combinedText: Average standard score over all five disciplines, among the clubs with a strength in all five that week: 0 is an average club, +1 one standard deviation above it. Gaps are weeks the club wasn't strong enough to be listed in every discipline.
club.seasonValues: Values at the end of each season (or the latest week for the current one).
club.strengthHistoryText: The club's strength at the end of each week: {rule}, counting players who played for the club at the time. Places it couldn't fill count at the lowest rating among ranked players. Gaps are weeks without any ranked player.
club.noPlayers: No ranked players: nobody from {club} has played {pool} in the last 12 months.
club.rankNoteMixed: # is the national rank in {pool}, among men or among women.
